title: Queenstown: Southern Alps Adrenaline
summary: New Zealand's adventure capital, used properly — Milford Sound at dawn, a Southern Alps hike, jet-boating, and a Central Otago vineyard to slow back down.
highlights: Milford Sound by boat at first light
A guided hike in the Remarkables

itinerary.title: Arrive in Queenstown
itinerary.description: Settle in, lakefront, with a day to acclimatize.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound
itinerary.description: An early departure to beat the day-trip crowds, boat cruise included.

itinerary.title: Remarkables hike
itinerary.description: A guided alpine hike with views over Lake Wakatipu.

itinerary.title: Jet boat & free afternoon
itinerary.description: The Shotover River by jet boat, then time to explore town.

itinerary.title: Central Otago
itinerary.description: Two nights among the vineyards, tastings included.

itinerary.title: Glenorchy day
itinerary.description: A scenic drive to the head of the lake, on foot for part of it.

itinerary.title: Depart Queenstown
itinerary.description: A final morning before your transfer to the airport.

included: The Milford Sound cruise and jet boat ride
Daily breakfast, 3 dinners including a vineyard lunch
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
